Summon Aleph-1's Creation to deal {0} Glacio DMG 5 times and {1} Glacio DMG 1 time to enemies.
The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains {2} Glacio DMG Bonus and {3} Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.
CD: {4}s

rocksteady-guardian.name: Rocksteady Guardian
rocksteady-guardian.description:
Transform into Rocksteady Guardian and enter a Parry State. Upon being attacked, deal Spectro DMG equal to {0} of the Resonator's Max HP, and perform a follow-up attack that deals Spectro DMG equal to {0} of the Resonator's Max HP.
 
Use the Echo Skill again to exit the transformation.
 
If the attack received is a <color=Highlight>Special Skill</color> attack, interrupt the enemy's <color=Highlight>Special Skill</color>, gain a Shield equal to 30% Max HP, and perform a two-stage follow-up attack, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to {1} of the Resonator's Max HP. These follow-up attacks simultaneously launch three ground-breaking waves, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to {2} of the Resonator's Max HP.
 
CD: {3}s

sabercat-prowler.name: Sabercat Prowler
sabercat-prowler.description:
Summon a Sabercat Prowler to fire beams at enemies, dealing {0} Havoc DMG.

CD: {1}s.

sabercat-reaver.name: Sabercat Reaver
sabercat-reaver.description:
Summon a Sabercat Reaver to attack enemies, dealing {0} Fusion DMG.

CD: {1}s.

sacerdos.name: Sacerdos
sacerdos.description:
Summon a Sacerdos to attack enemies, dealing {0} Aero DMG 2 times.
CD: {1}s.

sagittario.name: Sagittario
sagittario.description:
Transform into Sagittario to move a certain distance and perform a ranged attack, dealing {0} Spectro DMG.
Getting attacked while moving in the Sagittario form triggers form triggers a damage avoiding enhanced Dodge Counter, dealing {1} Spectro DMG once and {2} Spectro DMG 5 times.
CD: {3}s.

sentry-construct.name: Sentry Construct
sentry-construct.description:
Transform into Sentry Construct and attack enemies in front, dealing {0} Glacio DMG. Each time the Resonator with this Echo casts Resonance Liberation, it charges the Strike Capacitor.
Once Strike Capacitor is at max level, the Echo Skill cooldown will be reset. Use Echo Skill to transform into Sentry Construct and dive into enemies from the air, dealing {1} Glacio DMG and freezing the target.
The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot gains {2} Glacio DMG Bonus and {3} Resonance Skill DMG Bonus.
CD: {4}s.

shadow-stepper.name: Shadow Stepper
shadow-stepper.description:
Summon a Shadow Stepper to attack enemies, dealing {0} Havoc DMG.
CD: {1}s.

sigillum.name: Sigillum
sigillum.description:
Summon Sigillum to unleash two attacks, dealing {0} and {1} Fusion DMG respectively.
When equipped in the main slot by Aemeath, it grants {2} Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.
CD: {3}s

skywatch-lancer.name: Skywatch Lancer
skywatch-lancer.description:
Summon a Skywatch Lancer to attack the target, dealing {0} Aero DMG 6 times.
CD: {1}s

smiter.name: Smiter
smiter.description:
Use Echo Skill to summon a Smiter to jab at enemies, dealing 7 instances of {0} Spectro DMG, and finish with an uppercut, dealing {1} Spectro DMG.

CD: {2}s

smolder.name: Smolder
smolder.description:
Use Echo Skill to summon Smolder to hurl fireballs toward enemies, dealing {0} Fusion DMG. If the fireball hits the ground, it explodes to deal {0} Fusion DMG to all enemies within the range.

CD: {1}s

soulfrayer.name: Soulfrayer
soulfrayer.description:
Use Echo Skill to summon a Soulfrayer, dealing {0} Electro DMG 3 times.
Casting Outro Skill within {1}s after summoning Soulfrayer grants {2} Electro DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for {3}s.
CD: {4}s

spearback.name: Spearback
spearback.description:
Summon a Spearback to perform 5 consecutive attacks. The first 4 attacks deal {0} Physical DMG, and the last deals {1} Physical DMG.

CD: {2}s

spectro-drake.name: Spectro Drake
spectro-drake.description:
Summon a Spectro Drake to attack enemies, dealing {0} Spectro DMG 3 times.
CD: {1}s

spectro-prism.name: Spectro Prism
spectro-prism.description:
Summon a Spectro Prism to emit a laser that hits the enemy up to {0} times, dealing {1} Spectro DMG each time.

CD: {2}s

stone-picket.name: Stone Picket
stone-picket.description:
Use Echo Skill to summon a Stone Picket, dealing {0} Aero DMG.

CD: {1}s

stonewall-bracer.name: Stonewall Bracer
stonewall-bracer.description:
Transform into Stonewall Bracer and charge forward, dealing {0} Physical DMG on-hit, then smash to deal {1} Physical DMG, and gain a shield of {2} of current character's Max HP that lasts {3}s. Use the Echo skill again to exit the transformation state.

CD: {4}s

tambourinist.name: Tambourinist
tambourinist.description:
Summon a Tambourinist that plays out Melodies of Annihilation. Any Resonator on the team gains the following effect for 10s upon obtaining a Melody of Annihilation: When the Resonator hits a target, the Tambourinist deals {0} Havoc DMG to the target, up to 10 times.

CD: {1}s

tempest-mephis.name: Tempest Mephis
tempest-mephis.description:
Transform into Tempest Mephis to perform tail swing attacks followed by a claw attack. The lightning strike summoned by the tail swing deals {0} Electro DMG each time, while the claw attack deals {1} Electro DMG.

After the claw hit, increase the current character's Electro DMG by {2} and Heavy Attack DMG by {3} for {4}s.

CD: {5}s

thousand-puppet-pavilion.name: Thousand-Puppet Pavilion
thousand-puppet-pavilion.description:
Use Echo Skill to attack nearby enemies, dealing {1} Havoc DMG and summoning 4 Blades of Thousand Memories that last {5}s.

While Blades of Thousand Memories last, when the Resonator inflicts Havoc Bane, consume 1 Blade of Thousand Memories to deal {0} Havoc DMG once to the target. This effect can be triggered once every {6}s.

Resonators with this Echo equipped in the main slot gain {2} Havoc DMG and {3} Heavy Attack DMG bonuses.

CD: {4}s

thundering-mephis.name: Thundering Mephis
thundering-mephis.description:
Transform into Thundering Mephis, engaging in a rapid assault of up to 6 strikes. The first 5 strikes deal {0} Electro DMG each, while the final strike inflicts {1} Electro DMG, with an additional {2} Electro DMG from the thunder.

After the final hit, increase the current character's Electro DMG by {3} and Resonance Liberation DMG by {4} for {5}s.

CD: {6}s

tick-tack.name: Tick Tack
tick-tack.description:
Summon a Tick Tack that charges and bites the enemy. The charge from Tick Tack will deal {0} Havoc DMG to the enemy, and the bite will deal {1} Havoc DMG to the enemy. Reduces enemy Vibration Strength by up to {3} during {2}s.

CD: {4}s

tremor-warrior.name: Tremor Warrior
tremor-warrior.description:
Transform into a Tremor Warrior and viciously attack enemies in the front, dealing {0} Electro DMG.

CD: {1}s.

twin-nova-collapsar-blade.name: Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade
twin-nova-collapsar-blade.description:
Transform into a Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade to rapidly fire at enemies for 5s, with each attack dealing {0} Electro DMG.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains {6} Electro DMG Bonus and {7} Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

CD: {11}s.

If Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon is equipped in another slot on the Resonator:
- Casting Echo Skill in succession transforms you into Collapsar Blade and Nebulous Cannon alternately and is considered casting Echo skills of the same name.
- DMG dealt by Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade becomes Spectro DMG. The Electro DMG Bonus gained from equipping it in the main slot is turned into Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Casting Basic Attacks grants <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Dyad Origins. Casting Resonance Skill grants <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Dyad Origins. Dyad Origins can stack up to {3} times and lasts for {4}s. Each stack increases Echo Skill DMG by {5}, and all stacks are cleared after this Echo Skill ends.
- This skill is capped at {10} uses. Initially, this skill can be used {8} times, with 1 use added every {9}s.

twin-nova-nebulous-cannon.name: Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon
twin-nova-nebulous-cannon.description:
Transform into a Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon to slash enemies twice, with each attack dealing {0} Spectro DMG.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains {6} Spectro DMG Bonus and {7} Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

CD: {11}s.

If Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade is equipped in another slot on the Resonator:
- Casting Echo Skill in succession transforms you into Nebulous Cannon and Collapsar Blade alternately and is considered casting Echo skills of the same name. The DMG Bonus from the Echo in the main slot remains unchanged.
- DMG dealt by Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade becomes Spectro DMG.
- Casting Basic Attacks grants <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Dyad Origins. Casting Resonance Skill grants <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Dyad Origins. Dyad Origins can stack up to {3} times and lasts for {4}s. Each stack increases Echo Skill DMG by {5}, and all stacks are cleared after this Echo Skill ends.
-This skill is capped at {10} uses. Initially, this skill can be used {8} times, with 1 use added every {9}s.

violet-feathered-heron.name: Violet-Feathered Heron
violet-feathered-heron.description:
Transform into Violet-Feathered Heron and enter a Parry Stance. Counterattack when the Parry stance is over, dealing {0} Electro DMG. If attacked during Parry Stance, you can counterattack in advance and additionally recover {1} Concerto Energy.

CD: {2}s

viridblaze-saurian.name: Viridblaze Saurian
viridblaze-saurian.description:
Summon a Viridblaze Saurian to continuously spit fire, dealing {0} Fusion DMG 10 times.

CD: {1}s

vitreum-dancer.name: Vitreum Dancer
vitreum-dancer.description:
Transform into Vitreum Dancer and attack surrounding enemies, dealing {0} Electro DMG.
The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot gains {1} Electro DMG Bonus.
CD: {2}s.

voidwing-moth.name: Voidwing Moth
voidwing-moth.description:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Echo Skill to transform into Voidwing Moth, dealing {0} Spectro DMG to nearby enemies.
Hold Echo Skill to continuously attack, dealing up to 12 instances of {1} Spectro DMG.
Within {2}s after using this Echo skill, casting Outro Skill increases the incoming Resonator's ATK by {3} for {4}s.
CD: {5}s

voltscourge-stalker.name: Voltscourge Stalker
voltscourge-stalker.description:
Summon a Voltscourge Stalker to perform 3 stages of attacks on enemies, each dealing {0} Electro DMG.
CD: {1}s.

whiff-whaff.name: Whiff Whaff
whiff-whaff.description:
Summon a Whiff Whaff that triggers an air explosion, dealing {0} Aero DMG and produce a Low-pressure Zone. The Low-pressure Zone continuously pulls enemies nearby towards the center for {1}s, dealing {2} Aero DMG up to 6 times.

CD: {3}s

windlash-coleoid.name: Windlash Coleoid
windlash-coleoid.description:
Transform into a Windlash Coleoid to kick enemies, dealing {0} Aero DMG.

CD: {1}s.

zip-zap.name: Zip Zap
zip-zap.description:
Summon a Zip Zap to launch spinning attacks at enemies, dealing {0} Electro DMG 5 times.

CD: {1}s.
